versions.changelog:
- SKILL.md fully revised: introduction streamlined, content reorganized, new section organization, and more concise explanations.
- Added trigger keywords to the description for improved discoverability.
- Clarified content permissions and user customization rules.
- Simplified/deduplicated domain structure, usage rules, and execution framework content.
- Reorganized key abilities and workflow into clearer, step-based instructions.

- Initial release of business-domain-payload, covering 10 core business subdomains common to all organizations with 289 tasks.
- Supports business scenarios such as intelligence collection, data analysis, content production, operations, knowledge management, compliance, certification, and supply chain.
- Includes a calibration mechanism to adapt core processes to different industries using calibration tasks and parameters.
- Provides a three-layer structure: task list and dependency topology, task requirements, and exemplar library.
- Allows flexible usage with downgrade modes for scenarios lacking full framework or calibration.
- Designed for integration with the Meta Skill System execution framework; supports task automation, semi-automation, and auxiliary modes.
